name: HELP_PHONE_BLUE_SQUARE

g7_phone.desc: telephone handset symbol in a 400x500 box; artwork not dimensioned; box = handset ink extent (the HELP/PHONE legend intrudes into the drawn 400 x 500 frame, so the traced file is pruned to the handset subpath after tracing)

notes: G7-13B (Illust.) 600x600 R50, blue edge 10 + white border 10 (20/10 dims). Handset symbol box 400 wide x 500 high (50 top/bottom); the 400|200 chain starts at the sign edge so the box x is 0-400 as chained (the '10' at the bottom left may instead mean x 10). HELP 80 C 304|230|66 (AS 1744 width 214, 7% narrower - drawing figure kept), PHONE 80 B 301|237|62 (AS 1744 230). Vertical 100|80 C|50|80 B|290. QA: handset box taken as x 10 to 400 (the 10 at the bottom left read as the box's inset from the edge, the 400 chained from the edge). QA: handset box set to its ink extent (61,72 / 282 x 456) measured within the drawn frame; the legend overlaps the frame, so the symbol file keeps only the handset subpath (re-tracing brings the H and P back unless pruned again).
accepted_drawing_discrepancy: HELP 80 C = 214 vs 230, PHONE 80 B = 230 vs 237; drawn wider than AS 1744, no series fits; intervene set
